query:
insert or ignore into DirectProductReqTraces (
                collect_nr,
                product_id,
                req_id,
                filepath,
                file_hash,
                line
            )
            select last_collect_nr, $2 as product_id, req_id, $3 as filepath, file_hash, line
            from DetectedReqTraces
            where last_collect_nr = $1
            and file_hash = $4

            union

            select last_collect_nr, product_id, req_id, $3 as filepath, file_hash, line
            from DetectedProductReqTraces
            where last_collect_nr = $1
            and product_id = $2
            and file_hash = $4
